findings.issue: Example uses the nonstandard writing 盗られた (furigana とられた) instead of 盗まれた (ぬすまれた), contradicting the rule the same lesson teaches (盗む → 盗まれた). As read (とられた) it is the passive of 取る, not 盗む.
findings.current: <jp reading="しょくひんがしんごうのちかくでとられた">食品が信号の近くで盗られた</jp>
findings.suggested: <jp reading="しょくひんがしんごうのちかくでぬすまれた">食品が信号の近くで盗まれた</jp>

findings.issue: Self-contradictory vowel-length claim: the same string しょう is presented as both the short and the long member of the 'minimal pair'. The intended contrast is しょ (curto) vs しょう (longo).
findings.current: Note os pares mínimos de duração: しょう (curto) versus しょう longo muda a palavra inteira.
findings.suggested: Note os pares mínimos de duração: しょ (curto) versus しょう (longo) muda a palavra inteira: 処理 (しょり) x 証明 (しょうめい).

findings.issue: The passive example writes 盗られた (read とられた), a non-standard/colloquial form; 盗 has no jōyō reading とる and the lesson itself teaches 盗む → 盗まれた (ぬすまれた). Both the JP text and the furigana attribute are wrong.
findings.current: <jp reading="しょくひんがしんごうのちかくでとられた">食品が信号の近くで盗られた</jp>
findings.suggested: <jp reading="しょくひんがしんごうのちかくでぬすまれた">食品が信号の近くで盗まれた</jp>

findings.issue: Incoherent mora-length claim: the same string しょう is presented as both the short and the long member of the minimal pair. The vocabulary list actually contrasts しょ/じょ (処理, 徐々に) with しょう/じょう (証明, 情報).
findings.current: Note os pares mínimos de duração: しょう (curto) versus しょう longo muda a palavra inteira.
findings.suggested: Note os pares mínimos de duração: しょ (curto) versus しょう (longo) muda a palavra inteira.

findings.issue: The tip's closing advice contradicts the rule just taught and would induce errors: with perception verbs (見る/聞く) こと is not acceptable, as the lesson itself states ('Trocar por こと aqui soaria estranho').
findings.current: Na dúvida no começo, こと quase sempre soa aceitável.
findings.suggested: Na dúvida, lembre que com verbos de percepção o の é obrigatório: こと não funciona nesses casos.
